subject: general
question: Which of the following reports, prepared in the 1940s, was specifically prepared on the Agricultural prices?
solution:
The correct answer is the **__Krishnamachari report.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Rao Bahadur **Sir Vangal Thiruvenkatachari Krishnamachari** KCSI, KCIE (8 February 1881 – 14 February 1964) was an Indian civil servant and administrator.
 
• He served as the **Diwan of Baroda**** from 1927 to 1944, Prime Minister of ****Jaipur State**** from 1946 to 1949,** and as a member of the **Rajya Sabha from 1961 to 1964.**
 
• He was staunch in his support for the **major ****Indian Princely**** states **to join the Indian Union.
 
• The **Krishnamachari Report **was focused on **Agricultural prices**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gadgil Report:**​ **To assess the status of ecology, and demarcate areas within the Western Ghats Region for notifying ecologically sensitive zones under the Environment (Protection) Act, 1986**.
 
• **Saraiya Committee: **
 
 
• **​**The committee presented a report on** **Cooperatives. 
 
• He **found cooperative societies to be the most suitable medium for the democratization of economic planning and examined each area of economic development.**
 
 
 
• **Kheragat Report**: The report focused on Agricultural Development
